name: bug_css_only_remount
description: CSS-ONLY REMOUNT DOES NOT RELAYOUT. Two mounts with IDENTICAL html and only a changed stylesheet (#sidebar width 200px -> 40px) leave the solved geometry at 200px. Found 2026-08-14 while writing the animation transition test: every FLIP came out identity because First and Last were both 200, so nothing animated. The width is deliberately 40px rather than 0px, to separate two candidate causes — if 0px were the problem (a dropped/ignored zero-length declaration) this test would pass, and the fact that it fails at 40px means the new stylesheet is not reaching layout at all. That points at reuse: the second mount produces a structurally identical tree, and whatever decides the geometry can be kept is not consulting the cascade. The fix is a CSS diff alongside the DOM diff at reconciliation time, so a matched node whose layout-affecting properties changed cannot have its geometry reused.

css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
